name: @aion/object
description: Minimum pre-stable Universal Object reference implementation

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aion/identity && npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/identity && npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js" "dist-test/test/object.test.js"
scripts.test:canonical: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/canonical.test.js"
scripts.test:repository: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/repository.test.js" "dist-test/test/file-repository.test.js"
scripts.test:families: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/families.test.js"
scripts.test:relationships: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/relationships.test.js"
scripts.test:operations: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/operations.test.js"
scripts.test:limits: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/resource-limits.test.js"
